development.policy: greedy legal Q-only; no epsilon; no M4 guidance; no gradients; no replay insertion; no Stockfish

extension.selection: The three strongest stage-1 candidates by scheduled-game score, then fewer incomplete episodes, stronger SimpleHeuristic score, then earlier snapshot; tie-breaks follow the campaign selection rule.

selection: Maximize (wins + 0.5 * true draws) / scheduled games; incomplete/truncated games add zero and remain in the denominator.
development.evaluation_seed_derivation: videochess_rl.rl.evaluate._scenario_seed with frozen stage seed, opponent, and agent color

reserved_final.policy_set: selected Q checkpoint and M4-A; include accepted historical M5 only if the private artifact exists and fits the remaining evaluation budget
